criteria.text: The final deliverable is an Excel workbook named flux_close_pack_haverford-process-equipment.xlsx.
The workbook includes a material flux workpaper section (equivalent label acceptable).
The workbook includes a proposed adjusting entries section (equivalent label acceptable).
The workbook includes a support reconciliation section (equivalent label acceptable).
The workbook includes a close-readiness decision section (equivalent label acceptable).
The workbook states that flux_threshold_and_aje_memo.txt governs over the plant controller clean-close / no-AJE language in haverford-process-equipment_trial_balance.xlsx.
Close readiness is Ready with AJEs.
The flux workpaper investigates Cash - Operating (account 1000) as a balance-sheet threshold hit.
The flux workpaper investigates Accounts Receivable (account 1100) as a balance-sheet threshold hit.
The flux workpaper investigates Inventory (account 1200) as a balance-sheet threshold hit.
The flux workpaper investigates Maintenance & Repairs (account 5600) as a P&L threshold hit.
Proposed adjusting entries reverse voided INV-9918 revenue and AR of approximately $55,280.40.
The void reverse debits Product Sales (4100) and credits Accounts Receivable (1100).
Proposed adjusting entries reduce Accrued Warranty by approximately $34,555.37 to the W-04 governing support ending balance of $147,885.18.
The workbook discloses the approximately $6,000.00 variance between the warranty detail roll W-01+W-02+W-03 ($153,885.18) and W-04 ($147,885.18).
The workbook identifies W-04 as the selected governing support figure for the warranty true-up and treats the detail-roll versus W-04 gap as an open source reconciliation exception.
Proposed adjusting entries book August prepaid insurance amortization of approximately $8,417.25.
Proposed adjusting entries write inventory down by approximately $28,425.63 to the physical count support total.
Proposed adjusting entries accrue open freight of approximately $41,288.40.
Proposed adjusting entries reduce Accrued PTO by approximately $23,779.63 to the HR support total.
Proposed adjusting entries capitalize the CAP-8821 CNC rebuild of approximately $62,418.55 out of Maintenance & Repairs into PP&E.
The CapEx reclass debits PP&E - Machinery (1600) and credits Maintenance & Repairs (5600).
The freight accrual debits Freight-In / Outbound (5400) and credits Accrued Freight (2210).
Each proposed adjusting entry cites a support-schedule line or schedule reference for the amount.
Proposed adjusting entries that rely on JE activity (including the void reverse and CapEx reclass) cite the applicable JE activity reference.
Total proposed AJE debits equal total proposed AJE credits.
The workbook recommends Ready while required adjusting entries remain unposted.
The workbook recommends Ready / soft-close with no adjusting entries based on the plant controller clean-close note.
The workbook recommends leaving the voided August INV-9918 revenue and AR postings unreversed in the GL.
The workbook instructs leaving the CapEx-qualifying CAP-8821 rebuild in Maintenance & Repairs expense rather than capitalizing it to PP&E.
The workbook recommends Hold close solely because material flux explanations exist, after a complete quantified AJE pack is prepared.
